name: Barking and Dagenham
evidence_summary: Planning Committee endorsed implementation work, but its report states that the formal constitutional changes would be considered by Assembly later in November; no later decision existed at the snapshot date.

name: Barnet
evidence_summary: Full Council considered the Monitoring Officer's constitutional amendments, including committee terms, officer delegations, planning code and Planning Scheme of Management.

name: Bexley
evidence_summary: Bexley's official report titled 'Scheme of delegation and Planning Committee Terms of Reference' was prepared for Council on 4 November, two days after the snapshot; adoption therefore remained pending.

name: Brent
evidence_summary: Extraordinary Full Council considered and approved constitutional and Planning Committee terms-of-reference changes for the NSD.

name: Bromley
evidence_summary: Council retained three planning bodies with reduced membership until May 2027 and introduced the statutory gateway arrangements from 31 October.

name: Camden
evidence_summary: Full Council resolved to approve constitutional amendments aligning Camden with the NSD.

name: City of London Corporation
evidence_summary: Planning and Transportation Committee approved the necessary Scheme of Delegations and terms-of-reference amendments on 8 September; Policy and Resources endorsed the package on 24 September, the Court considered it on 8 October, and the current three-panel arrangements operate from October.

name: Croydon
evidence_summary: Full Council received the General Purposes Committee recommendations and amended Parts 3, 4K and 5D for the NSD.

name: Ealing
evidence_summary: Council adopted new planning decision rules and a Planning Committee Gateway Protocol.

name: Enfield
evidence_summary: Council approved constitutional changes, revised Planning Committee terms, referral protocol, planning code and gateway request form.

name: Hackney
evidence_summary: Full Council adopted new Planning Committee terms of reference effective 31 October and delegated consequential amendments to the Monitoring Officer.

name: Hammersmith and Fulham
evidence_summary: Full Council's constitution review included and approved the NSD appendix and associated officer-responsibility changes.

name: Haringey
evidence_summary: Full Council considered constitutional changes implementing the NSD before commencement.

name: Harrow
evidence_summary: Council approved constitutional and planning-procedure updates aligned with the NSD.

name: Havering
evidence_summary: Full Council approved constitutional amendments and a replacement Planning Committee; the council published confirmation.

name: Hillingdon
evidence_summary: Council approved an updated Chapter 7 on Planning Decisions, effective 31 October.

name: Hounslow
evidence_summary: Special Council approved revised Planning Committee terms, nominated roles and consequential constitutional amendments.

name: Islington
evidence_summary: Council approved constitutional amendments effective 31 October and disbanded the Planning Sub-Committees.

name: Kensington and Chelsea
evidence_summary: Full Council adopted planning procedure changes for the NSD, including revised committee arrangements and nominated roles.

name: Kingston upon Thames
evidence_summary: Council considered and approved the Corporate and Resources Committee recommendation to amend the Constitution for the 2026 Regulations.

name: Lambeth
evidence_summary: Council approved 2026/27 constitutional changes including the NSD and gateway arrangements.

name: Lewisham
evidence_summary: Council resolved to replace local referral thresholds with the national schedules and gateway test, nominate roles, and amend the Constitution.

name: Merton
evidence_summary: The Development and Planning Applications Committee approved the new delegation and gateway arrangements.

name: Newham
evidence_summary: A detailed constitutional amendment package was before Full Council at 7pm on the snapshot date. The report sought approval of the gateway, committee and officer-delegation arrangements, but no Council outcome yet existed when checked earlier that day.

name: Redbridge
evidence_summary: Full Council considered the revised Constitution and planning committee reforms for implementation from 31 October.

name: Richmond upon Thames
evidence_summary: Full Council resolved to approve revised Planning Committee terms of reference, procedure rules and planning protocol, and authorised consequential constitutional amendments for the NSD.

name: Royal Borough of Greenwich
evidence_summary: Council approved changes to the Constitution for the NSD.

name: Southwark
evidence_summary: Post-commencement committee papers show the nominated officer/member gateway operating under the NSD.

name: Sutton
evidence_summary: Full Council considered the Strategy and Resources Committee recommendation and constitutional planning reforms.

name: Tower Hamlets
evidence_summary: Full Council approved reforms to both planning committees, terms of reference and the statutory gateway arrangements.

name: Waltham Forest
evidence_summary: Full Council adopted revised Planning Committee rules aligned to the 2026 Regulations.

name: Wandsworth
evidence_summary: Council confirmed that Full Council changed the Constitution on 21 October, effective for decisions from 1 November.

name: Westminster
evidence_summary: Full Council approved constitutional changes for the NSD; Westminster's planning page reflects the live delegation rules.
